info.title: Mentingo Helpdesk
info.description: Public version-aware tutorial search and authenticated direct-to-Bunny publishing, verification and indexing.

201.description: Draft created, or original response replayed

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag returned by the last read, e.g. quoted 1

202.description: Verification and indexing queued; still private until publish
Durable media preparation accepted; not upload/playback readiness

200.description: Verified media and complete indexes atomically become public
One-video TUS grant; expected size/hash are not enforced by its signature

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Comma-separated enabled public product feature keys.

202.description: Authenticated notification accepted; provider state will be re-fetched

expectedPublishedRevisionId.description: Null when there is no published predecessor for this tutorial/language.

contentType.description: The initial video workflow produces MP4.

expectedSha256.description: Publisher-provided SHA256. This is not verified by upload authorization.

version.description: Optimistic edit version, also returned as a strong ETag.

domainLabel.description: Readable app-area label in this revision's language; omitted by older publishers.

expectedDurationMs.description: Publisher estimate only; Bunny's measured duration is verified before publication later.

rankScore.description: Rank fusion orders results; this value is not a confidence probability.

SearchQueryMode.description: Requested retrieval strategy, independent from the returned execution/fallback mode.

mode.description: Omitted mode preserves hybrid retrieval; keyword never requests or uses vectors.

TutorialDomain.description: Stable app-area identity. New product areas require catalog data, not a service release.
